nodes.title: The Caudillo's Years
nodes.description: Franco remains the final arbiter of a regime divided between ministers, the Movement and the armed forces. His advancing age makes the question of who can govern in his absence an immediate matter of state.

effects.description: Political Power +50.
Unlock succession preparations; Franco's capacity declines over time. Preparations improve the handover, never restore health.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Rule by Delegation
nodes.description: Carrero Blanco and the technical ministries can handle the daily business of government. Delegation strengthens administrative continuity while loosening Franco's personal command of the regime.

effects.description: Succession Preparedness +10; the personal-command policy is excluded.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Personal Authority
nodes.description: The families of the regime still obey orders issued in the Caudillo's name. Preserving that authority can settle immediate disputes, but leaves more business unresolved when he can no longer intervene.

effects.description: Political Power +100.
Stability +5%.
Succession Preparedness -15; Political Power gain +10% while Franco remains, removed at his departure.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Cabinet Records
nodes.description: Succession cannot depend on an inaccessible collection of personal instructions. Ministers will record powers, budgets and outstanding commitments so that the administration can continue through an absence.

effects.description: Succession Preparedness +5.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Movement Commission
nodes.description: The National Council wants the principles of the Movement embedded in every ministry. Its coordinating commission offers political discipline at the price of another layer of supervision.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Carrero's Guarantees
nodes.description: Carrero's authority rests on Franco's confidence and his command of government business. A documented continuity agreement will give ministers a procedure to follow when the presidency changes hands.

effects.description: Stability +4%.
Succession Preparedness +5; improves the institutional response to a presidential vacancy, without guaranteeing Carrero's survival.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Command Channels
nodes.description: The military regions and security services must receive lawful orders from a recognised chain of command. Clarifying those channels reduces the risk that competing officials claim to speak for Franco.

effects.description: Succession Preparedness +5.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Interregnum Planning
nodes.description: The Fundamental Laws name institutions that can act during a vacancy, but their cooperation has never been tested. A joint exercise between the government, the Council of the Realm and the royal household will expose the missing arrangements.

effects.description: Succession Preparedness +10. Unlock the Council of Regency preparation.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The Prince's Briefings
nodes.description: Juan Carlos was designated successor in 1969 and has sworn to the laws of the regime. Giving him access to the business of state prepares a head of state without deciding whether a future monarchy will reform those laws.

effects.description: Succession Preparedness +5. Enable temporary delegation to Juan Carlos after the serious health crisis.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Council of the Realm
nodes.description: The Council links the presidency, the Cortes and the head of state under the existing legal order. Agreeing its procedures in advance makes a disputed appointment less likely.

effects.description: Succession Preparedness +5. Legal continuity survives a temporary absence of the head of state.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: A Lasting State
nodes.description: No successor will inherit Franco's wartime authority. The institutions of the state must be able to keep offices open and salaries paid while the political settlement is negotiated.

effects.description: Replace Competing Regime Families: bureaucracy cost +10% becomes +5%; stability penalty -5% becomes -2%.
Succession Preparedness +10.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Dawn Without Franco
nodes.description: The founder's departure leaves the institutions intact but their purpose contested. Ministers, the crown, the Movement and the opposition must now pursue their programmes without his final arbitration.

effects.description: Remove Ageing Leadership and its stage penalties. Apply the succession shock determined by preparedness.
Open settlement talks and governing-party programmes. No forced civil war or automatic foreign alignment.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The Fundamental Laws
nodes.description: The continuity camp proposes that the legal order survive its author. The Cortes and the Movement will remain the recognised channels of representation, excluding competitive national elections.

effects.description: Adopt an authoritarian legal settlement. Later governing changes can reopen constitutional reform; this focus does not permanently exclude other party programmes.
Remove the remaining succession-family penalties if present.
Remove the remaining succession-family penalties if present.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The Crown Governs
nodes.description: Royal advisers argue that the crown must exercise the executive power inherited under the succession laws. A consultative Cortes can broaden support while the king retains the appointment of government.

effects.description: Adopt an executive monarchy. Cabinet responsibility remains to the crown; future constitutional revision remains possible.
Remove the remaining succession-family penalties if present.
Remove the remaining succession-family penalties if present.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Reform Through Law
nodes.description: Reformers can use the institutions of the regime to dismantle their monopoly. A reform law, a public vote and competitive elections offer an orderly route to a new parliament, provided the coercive institutions accept the process.

effects.description: Stability +5%.
Start a staged reform agreement: legal guarantees, referendum, election, constituent Cortes. Legalise participating parties through the actual native party system; no instant all-party cabinet.
Remove the remaining succession-family penalties if present.
Remove the remaining succession-family penalties if present.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The Constitutional Pact
nodes.description: A settlement needs procedures for changing it as well as rules for governing under it. The constitutional pact gives a future government a lawful route to revision instead of treating the first compromise as permanent consent.

effects.description: Unlock a paid, staged revision of the legal settlement after an actual governing change. Retire replaced constitutional modifiers. The revision does not repay completed focus rewards.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Parliamentary Crown
nodes.description: A parliamentary monarchy separates the continuity of the state from the direction of government. The king will represent the state while ministers answer to an elected Cortes.

effects.description: Stability +5%.
Ratify parliamentary monarchy by constitutional process; replace the preceding executive settlement.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: A Republican Mandate
nodes.description: Republican parties must turn a historical claim into a public mandate. A constitutional referendum can establish a republic with guarantees for political minorities and a negotiated transfer of the headship of state.

effects.description: Political Power +75.
Recipient-owned domestic constitutional vote; success requires a legal parliamentary mandate. Stability -5% during the 180-day constituent period, then remove the transition penalty.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The Succession Law
nodes.description: The 1969 designation establishes a successor, but the law also defines who must act during a vacancy. The government will publish the legal procedure without requiring agreement on the future political programme.

effects.description: Political Power +25.
Establish the legal handover procedure. Preparation focuses remain optional: even an unprepared state can complete the succession after Franco leaves office.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The Internal Question
nodes.description: Industrial disputes and territorial grievances cannot be reduced to one conspiracy. The government must distinguish peaceful representation from violence and decide how much political space it can tolerate.

effects.description: Political Power +50.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: One Administration
nodes.description: Central administrators propose uniform services and provincial investment under the governors. This can improve access to the state while leaving demands for political autonomy unanswered.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Negotiated Statutes
nodes.description: Regional representatives seek elected institutions with defined powers and financing. Negotiated statutes can bring lawful opposition into government, but establishing parallel administrations carries a recurring cost.

effects.description: Stability +6%.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Provincial Equalisation
nodes.description: Services in poorer provinces must improve if central government expects allegiance. Targeted public works in Extremadura will give administrative unity a material purpose.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Basque Fiscal Accord
nodes.description: A fiscal agreement must specify both local responsibility and the contribution to shared services. A negotiated accord offers institutional certainty without treating the Basque population as a security category.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Catalan Institutions
nodes.description: The restoration of regional institutions requires civil servants, offices and an agreed division of responsibilities. Funding that administration will make the statute operational rather than merely symbolic.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Municipal Works
nodes.description: Municipal authorities know which roads and utilities are holding back local employment. Earmarked works will let them deliver improvements within a common national investment framework.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Civil Guarantees
nodes.description: Public order requires courts capable of separating dissent from criminal violence. Clear arrest procedures and judicial supervision will reduce arbitrary detention while leaving investigators responsible for actionable cases.

effects.description: Territorial and Labour Strains: stability penalty -5% becomes -2%; police cost +10% becomes +5%.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Syndical Guarantees
nodes.description: The official syndicates can retain their institutional position only by enforcing credible workplace guarantees. Binding arbitration will raise labour costs while reducing the incentive to settle every dispute through stoppages.

effects.description: Stability +3%.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Independent Unions
nodes.description: Workers' organisations need legal recognition and employers need enforceable bargaining rules. Independent unions and collective agreements can legitimise representation while making wage negotiations a real constraint on government and industry.

effects.description: Stability +5%.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Labour Courts
nodes.description: A labour settlement needs more than periodic agreements among national leaders. Specialist courts will enforce contracts and provide a routine channel for disputes that would otherwise return to the streets.

effects.description: Remove the remaining -2% stability penalty of Territorial and Labour Strains; retain police expense +5%.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The Development State
nodes.description: Spain's industrial expansion has created factories, cities and a growing domestic market. The next programme must address the protected firms, regional gaps and energy demand that growth has left behind.

effects.description: Political Power +50.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Enterprise Audit
nodes.description: Before new credit is allocated, the state needs reliable accounts from public enterprises and protected private firms. A national review will identify productive investment and the losses hidden behind administrative protection.

effects.description: Protected Industrialisation: civilian productivity -10% becomes -5%; retain efficiency ceiling -5% and industrial construction +10%.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Renew the INI
nodes.description: Public enterprises provide capacity that private finance will not always build. Modernising their plants and purchasing rules can preserve that role, provided the state accepts the continuing cost of directing investment.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Export Competition
nodes.description: Access to foreign markets will reward firms that can compete beyond protected domestic contracts. A programme of industrial adjustment will improve productivity while withdrawing some of the construction privileges enjoyed by favoured enterprises.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Asturian Modernisation
nodes.description: Asturian heavy industry supplies the state and sustains communities with few alternatives. A funded modernisation programme will renew industrial capacity rather than promise that obsolete plant can remain competitive indefinitely.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Coastal Suppliers
nodes.description: Assembly plants need specialised local suppliers if exports are to leave more value in Spain. Investment in Catalonia and Valencia will connect engineering workshops to the larger industrial market.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Industrial Standards
nodes.description: Quality control, compatible components and reliable delivery are conditions of a modern industrial base. Common standards will turn isolated plant improvements into a national production system.

effects.description: Remove the remaining civilian-productivity -5% and production-efficiency-cap -5%; retain industrial construction +10%.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Southern Irrigation
nodes.description: Drought risk and uneven water access limit rural incomes in the south. Irrigation and water-management works can make agricultural investment productive without pretending that every province has the same resources.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Rural Credit
nodes.description: Small producers need finance for machinery, storage and access to buyers. Rural credit institutions will spread the benefits of development while increasing the state's obligation to support districts losing population.

effects.description: Uneven Prosperity: social expense +10% becomes +5%; keep office productivity +5%.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Agricultural Training
nodes.description: Technical services can make equipment and irrigation useful to the people operating them. Extension schools and cooperatives will support adaptation instead of treating urban migration as the only development policy.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Tourism Standards
nodes.description: Tourism brings foreign earnings and employment, but rapid coastal construction can overwhelm local services. Common standards and funded utilities will protect the sector's long-term value.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Regional Services
nodes.description: Commercial services should develop around more than the capital and the coast. A regional centre in Galicia will support local firms and give trained workers another reason to remain.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Technical Universities
nodes.description: The expansion of education must produce engineers and technicians as well as formal qualifications. Applied departments will support Spanish industry while committing the state to a larger education bill.

effects.description: Raise funded education by one native law level, unless already at the maximum; no endpoint PP refund.
effects.guard: Known education law below edu_05; skip entirely at maximum/unrecognised law. Never run endpoint PP refund.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The Energy Balance
nodes.description: Factories, transport and growing cities depend on a fuel and electricity system exposed to external supply. A credible energy policy must choose between faster conventional capacity and a more expensive nuclear programme.

effects.description: Open funded energy projects through existing MD investment. No free oil, uranium production or power plants.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Industrial Efficiency
nodes.description: Spain can reduce the energy required for each unit of industrial production before building another generating plant. Modern equipment and process audits will make the existing supply go further.

effects.description: Replace high industrial energy demand: civilian-factory energy use +10% becomes +5%.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: A Nuclear Programme
nodes.description: Nuclear generation offers a different source of electricity, but requires capital, specialist personnel and a secure fuel cycle. The state will fund site and safety work before authorising construction through the existing investment system.

effects.description: Use the actual MD funded reactor investment and technology requirements; this focus grants no reactor or uranium.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Conventional Capacity
nodes.description: Conventional stations can meet industrial demand with familiar technology and shorter construction schedules. That speed retains dependence on purchased fuel and ties future supply to foreign markets.

effects.description: Use the actual funded MD fossil-energy investment. Keep its fuel requirements and recurring running cost; no invented fossil-generation modifier.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Nuclear Operators
nodes.description: A reactor fleet is only as reliable as its operators and regulators. Specialist training will improve generation from operating plants while expanding the permanent technical administration.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Uranium Surveys
nodes.description: Domestic uranium resources must be surveyed and evaluated before they can support the fuel cycle. A deposit is an opportunity for paid development, not a mine or automatic production.

effects.description: Reveal eligible Spanish surveyed deposits through the existing Imperia uranium system. Initial mines and raw production remain zero; development is paid and deposit/slot gated.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Independent Inspection
nodes.description: Operators need an inspectorate able to stop unsafe production without bargaining over annual generation targets. Regular inspections improve institutional confidence while keeping a permanent administrative bill.

effects.description: Stability +3%.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Refining Skills
nodes.description: Refining and fuel management require their own technical base. Training and equipment will improve the output of existing fuel production without creating domestic oil deposits.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Strategic Reserves
nodes.description: Storage cannot make imported fuel domestic, but it can give industry and transport time to adjust to a disruption. A funded reserve facility will support a national supply plan.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Supply Contingencies
nodes.description: A supply interruption must not leave ministries competing for the same deliveries. Contingency plans will prioritise essential transport and public services, accepting administrative cost in exchange for a more coherent response.

effects.description: A later oil-supply crisis applies a shorter adjustment penalty if the reserve facility remains owned. No permanent immunity to imported fuel prices.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: National Laboratories
nodes.description: National laboratories can support industrial measurement, materials and energy research beyond a single policy programme. The investment creates a lasting technical institution rather than a temporary cabinet office.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Freight Corridors
nodes.description: Industrial regions need reliable routes to ports and domestic markets. Targeted infrastructure in Aragon and Valencia will connect production centres without promising that a focus can replace every missing railway.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Technical Exports
nodes.description: Spanish firms should be able to sell engineering services as well as assembled goods. Export support tied to proven technical capacity will turn the laboratories and industrial standards into practical opportunities.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Reconversion Fund
nodes.description: Industrial adjustment can destroy the communities it is meant to modernise. A funded retraining and redevelopment reserve will make closures and new investment part of the same policy.

effects.description: When a historical industrial-reconversion crisis occurs, reduce its temporary productivity penalty by 5 percentage points. This mitigation is applied once.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The Service Review
nodes.description: The armed forces retain political weight and an uneven inventory alongside equipment obtained through foreign agreements. Modernisation must define their mission before ministries compete over procurement.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: A Defence Ministry
nodes.description: Separate service interests make national planning expensive and slow. A common defence administration will bring accounts and procurement under one authority while creating a permanent civilian and military staff.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Professional Cadres
nodes.description: A smaller body of instructors and technical specialists can improve training and readiness. Retaining those people requires better pay and career prospects rather than an unexplained increase in manpower.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: A Trained Reserve
nodes.description: A territorial reserve can provide depth without keeping every soldier permanently under arms. Its usefulness depends on exercises, stores and mobilisation planning that divert resources from the standing force.

effects.description: Permit the next native conscription-law step through the normal legal and affordability requirements; no free manpower or automatic draft escalation.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The Instructor Corps
nodes.description: The best specialists should teach the force rather than disappear into headquarters. An instructor corps will spread practical skills while reducing the personnel available for routine postings.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Mobilisation Exercises
nodes.description: Reserve units must assemble with usable equipment and clear transport arrangements. A funded mobilisation exercise will reveal shortages before they become operational failures.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The Joint Staff
nodes.description: A joint staff can reconcile the services' plans and standardise the force's basic procedures. The army will gain a clearer operational system while retaining the recurring cost of its chosen personnel model.

effects.description: Army of the Regime: remove organisation -10%; personnel expense +10% becomes +5%.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: A Continental Army
nodes.description: The army can concentrate on defending the peninsula and sustaining formations close to home. Larger stocks and prepared positions improve defensive resilience while making manoeuvre forces more supply intensive.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: A Mobile Force
nodes.description: A smaller mobile force can respond across the peninsula, the islands and the remaining Saharan commitment. Its vehicles and specialist crews demand a higher level of support than a static territorial army.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Defence in Depth
nodes.description: Prepared positions need trained staffs and a doctrine for committing reserves. The academy will concentrate on defensive operations rather than treating every unit as a force for rapid intervention.

effects.description: Two land-doctrine purchases at 50% reduced doctrine cost.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Combined Arms School
nodes.description: Mobile formations need artillery, engineers and logistics trained to work on the same timetable. A combined-arms school will turn imported and domestic equipment into usable operational formations.

effects.description: Two land-doctrine purchases at 50% reduced doctrine cost.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Domestic Workshops
nodes.description: A national maintenance and production base will keep the army from depending on every foreign delivery. The state will fund a limited expansion of military manufacturing in Castile.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Licensed Equipment
nodes.description: Licensing can provide proven designs before domestic development is mature. Production improvements are useful only when the foreign owner actually grants a licence and the equipment can be supported locally.

effects.description: Use native equipment licensing with the exporting player's consent. Grants no licence automatically.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: National Design Offices
nodes.description: Domestic design offices give the state more control over future equipment. Development will cost money before it produces a useful design and will not instantly erase the existing licensed inventory.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The Air Staff
nodes.description: Air defence, training and procurement must share a realistic operating plan. A central air staff will improve service coordination while keeping aircraft acquisition separate from the force's actual ability to fly them.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Interceptor Priority
nodes.description: Air sovereignty requires pilots and ground crews trained for interception. Concentrating instruction on that task will improve operational organisation without pretending to grant a new fighter fleet.

effects.description: One air-doctrine purchase at 50% reduced doctrine cost.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Joint Air Support
nodes.description: The air force can give priority to working with army formations and maritime patrols. Joint exercises will improve service planning while demanding transport, maintenance and flying hours.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Ground Crew Schools
nodes.description: Aircraft availability depends on technicians and stores as much as pilots. Dedicated ground-crew schools will build the workforce needed to sustain whichever aircraft the state can actually afford.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Dispersed Airfields
nodes.description: Dispersal protects the force and reduces dependence on a few crowded bases. A funded airfield expansion in Aragon will provide capacity for training and deployment.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The Naval Programme
nodes.description: Spain's Atlantic and Mediterranean approaches demand choices that the navy cannot finance simultaneously. The naval programme must decide between sea-lane protection and a more expensive force for sustained presence.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: An Escort Navy
nodes.description: Escorts and support vessels can protect trade and operate with partners without a large prestige fleet. The programme prioritises trained crews and sustainment over the number of major hulls.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: A Navy of Presence
nodes.description: A force designed for sustained overseas presence carries political weight but requires more than a flagship. Shipyard investment must be matched by crews, maintenance and an accepted recurring expense.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Ferrol Modernisation
nodes.description: Galicia's shipyards can support a navy built around reliable escorts. Funding new capacity there will create a practical link between naval planning and domestic construction.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Cádiz Modernisation
nodes.description: A larger operational fleet requires yards able to maintain it as well as build it. Investment in Andalusia will expand that capacity while leaving ship procurement to the actual naval production system.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Naval War College
nodes.description: Naval officers need a common framework for operations in two maritime theatres. A war college and fleet exercises will put the shipyard programme behind a usable doctrine.

effects.description: Two naval-doctrine purchases at 50% reduced doctrine cost.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Joint Logistics
nodes.description: The services should not maintain incompatible stores for every item they purchase. Common logistics will reduce unit supply demand while preserving the support costs of the chosen force structure.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The Service Oath
nodes.description: The armed forces must serve the recognised institutions of the state rather than individual patrons. A revised service oath and promotion code will support professional continuity through future changes of government.

effects.description: Remove the remaining Army of the Regime personnel expense +5%; political force-model modifiers remain.
Stability +3%.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: A Place in the World
nodes.description: Spain trades and hosts American facilities while remaining outside the Atlantic alliance and the European Communities. A diplomatic review will separate practical agreements from the question of permanent alignment.

effects.description: Political Power +50.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: The US Agreement
nodes.description: Access to facilities is a negotiable bilateral arrangement rather than automatic NATO membership. Spain can seek clearer terms and compensation while the United States retains the right to reject the proposal.

effects.description: Unlock a recipient-owned US facilities agreement. Proposed terms: US pays Spain 1.50 treasury once; Spain grants agreed access for 720 days. Acceptance required; no automatic US payment or alliance.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.

nodes.title: Restricted Facilities
nodes.description: The government can limit external use of Spanish facilities while continuing ordinary commerce. Greater discretion preserves freedom of action at the expense of assistance tied to the basing relationship.

effects.description: Political Power +75.
Offer limited access or renegotiate existing access through bilateral consent. Forgo the 1.50-treasury facilities package.

source.pattern: Native idea modifiers, bounded technology bonuses, treasury-funded assets; proposal values are Spain-specific.
